title: AnimationNode does not invalidate property_cache in some situations
body:
### Tested versions

master (commit c2202d36c10661873fb729bcf9c4c00b99e10c7a )
Godot 4.4.1 not affected

### System information

Windows 10, CPU AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor, GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti

### Issue description

At the beginning, I'm encountered error message (a lot of them) 'Type mismatch between initial and final value'. It's triggered from here https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c2202d36c10661873fb729bcf9c4c00b99e10c7a/scene/resources/animation.cpp#L5688 
I have got this callstack

After some investigation I found that the set_parameter function ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c2202d36c10661873fb729bcf9c4c00b99e10c7a/scene/animation/animation_tree.cpp#L83 ) was reading the wrong property from tree->property_map. 'p_name' is equal to 'backward' but property at the index returned from property_cache has a different name.
After that I start saving pointer process_state->tree in new variable near property_cache and compare saved value with current process_state->tree. I have some callstacks with non-empty property_cache when AnimationNode seems to use different tree->property_map value.
